camel_example: aliyun ossutil api list-bucket-anti-d-dos-info --region cn-hangzhou --max-keys 100 --marker nextMarker
description_en: Retrieves the list of bucket protection information
name: ListBucketAntiDDosInfo

parameters.description_en:
Specifies the marker after which Anti-DDoS instances are returned in alphabetical order.

> For the first request, set marker to an empty string. If IsTruncated in the response is true, use the marker field from the response as the parameter for the next request.
parameters.description_zh:
设定从marker之后按字母排序开始返回高防实例。

> 第一次请求时可以将marker设置为空字符串。如果返回结果中IsTruncated存在且为true，则需要将返回结果中的marker字段作为参数进行下一次请求。
